title: Correctness: sysfs algorithms_show TOCTOU OOB read
description:
Location: crypto2dev_cdev.c algorithms_show().

Trigger: Thread A calls crypto2dev_algo_count() → gets N. Thread B registers a new provider, increasing algo count to N+M. Thread A calls kmalloc_array(N, sizeof(*info)). Thread A calls crypto2dev_enumerate_algos(info, N) → returns N+M (total) but only writes N entries to info[]. Thread A loops 'for (i = 0; i < n; i++)' where n == N+M — reads info[N] through info[N+M-1] which are beyond the kmalloc'd buffer.

Bad outcome: heap out-of-bounds read. sysfs_emit_at() reads garbage bytes past the allocation boundary and emits them to the sysfs buffer. On a CONFIG_HARDENED_USERCOPY or KASAN kernel this is a kernel crash / BUG. On a non-hardened kernel it leaks heap memory contents into the sysfs output visible to any user with read access to /sys/class/misc/crypto2dev/algorithms.

Fix approach: use 'for (i = 0; i < min(n, count); i++)' or re-read under lock once, or pass count (not n) as the loop bound.
